notes: In the Photo Lab, a ticked face LoRA counts as the identity for the face pass whether or not its character is chosen in the dropdown. It rode the main paint either way, but the face pass only looked for it on the selected character's card, so with the character left at None the pass reported that no identity LoRA had ridden and sat out. The tick is the request; the dropdown only adds the appearance anchor and the gallery to save into.
